work.description: The act creates Francesco Antonio de Willo and his legitimate descendants barons. Issuer evidence GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF9818; own dating clause LF9894–9897 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctam Mariam Maio- rem sub annulo piscatoris die vigesima octava septembris millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo primo, pontificatus Nostri anno primo.. Own provenance note LF9834 excluded as edition furniture. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
